#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: How was it outside?
You: Alright I guess. A little cold.
Bot: That’s why I prepared a hot drink for you!
You: Thanks! What is it?
Bot: I used the coffee machine to make you something to warm up with!
Bot: It’s a special blend I prepared after studying coffee making materials available online.
You: You put a lot of work to it, huh.
Bot: Yes! I hope you will like it! 
You: Let me try it.
